what: A byte-for-byte DEV COPY of REAL nba-sim-v1-coherent engine output (not a synthetic fixture: it carries no fixture flag), rebuilt offline from committed inputs on main. Kept here only so the unlinked NBA Simulation Theater dev route can be built and reviewed before experimental-v1 artifacts are committed under data/. Read only; never edited. The theater refuses it unless this file's sha256 matches.
usage: TEST FIXTURE ONLY since 2026-10-20 (Cross-Product Prediction Consistency): the NBA Theater dev route reads the committed private receipt data/internal/research/nba/experimental-v1/forecasts/<date>.json (loader.mjs NBA_THEATER_SOURCE), verifies each game's receipt stamp, and never falls back to this copy. Unit tests read it as NBA_REAL_TEST_FIXTURE_SOURCE.
source: node app/scripts/nba/build-nba-experimental-forecasts.mjs --family v1 --date 2026-10-20 --now 2026-10-19T17:00:00Z --out .sprint-scratch/nba-v1-2026-10-20.json — run on branch claude/gtp-theater-integrate-20261019 (base main 9b6e923c1a, which includes the V1 minutes-rounding fix 29722959e1). No network, no paid API; inputs read only: data/internal/research/nba/{corpus-v1.json,boxscores/,rosters/latest.json (asOf 2026-10-19T16:25:36Z)}, data/internal/research/injuries/nba/latest.json (2026-10-19T16:25:54Z, sha256 c1b4f428616e8bfa973652db043e938ca32b8fba3622d3378910ae04c80c3b59), app/public/data/nba/schedule/latest.json, app/public/data/nba/results/finals-2026-27.json. Each game's receipt inside the artifact records its input hashes.

supersedes.why: built before the minutes-rounding fix (29722959e1): sample minutes summed to 239.98–240.02 per side. Removed from the tree; it remains in git history.

minutesNote: Built after 29722959e1 (largest-remainder rounding to 0.01): every sample's side minutes sum to exactly 240 + 25·OT. The theater therefore validates this copy with NO rounding allowance (validate-sample.mjs exactMinutes): any drift fails closed as MINUTES_SUM.
